allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000" -TimeoutSec 10 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Host \($r.Content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(2000, $r.Content.Length\)\)\) } catch { Write-Host "ERROR: $_" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/dashboard" -TimeoutSec 10 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "Dashboard status: $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { Write-Host "Dashboard ERROR: $_" })
